task: repeated prepared dense float32 CPU matrix multiplication with explicit provider ordering
route_contract: An x86-64 product explicitly configured with the oneDNN provider uses HYLE-native for M<16 and transposed weights, and oneDNN BRGEMM for supported M>=16 row-major shapes. Provider choice, JIT and workspace allocation occur before repeated submit.
comparison: Selected and forced-native arms use the same public HYLE Compute Tensor/Context/Queue/PreparedOperation/Invocation/Completion contract and the same caller-owned input/output tensors, serial execution and no hidden packing or copy. Each route overwrites the shared output and correctness is checked before timing. Complete warm operations alternate before timing; nanobench compare gives both rows one calibrated iteration count and cyclic paired interleaving. Artifact allocation and declared first-row order are crossed independently.
workload_matched_control: Before product sampling, HYLE_BENCH_AA_ROUTE=selected and =native replace both timed rows with the same complete public route for every shape while retaining storage, warmup, execution-order and placement topology.
